user.title: XMPP Ping
user.description: Sends a random token to a target JID and checks that the same token comes back. The target must run an echo responder.

data.jid: Bot JID (your XMPP account, e.g. bot@example.com)
data.target_jid: Target JID to ping (the echo address)
data.host: Server host (optional; auto-discovered via DNS if blank)

abort.already_configured: This bot JID / target JID pair is already configured.
